notes.title: Important Update & Sincere Apologies from 7 FUNNY
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Since the inception of this game, our indie team has faced challenges unique to game development:

Chronic shortages of technical expertise and development resources
Severe financial constraints threatening our sustainability
Critical bugs persisting post-launch despite multiple patch cycles

We sincerely apologize for:

The prolonged absence of updates
Incompatible system architectures discovered 
The necessity for a complete overhaul of core gameplay systems

Good News:

 Update coming soon：
Comprehensive bug-fix campaign (200+ issues resolved)
Fundamental architecture redesign
New gameplay mechanics implementation

Our Commitment:
"Game as Life, Life as Game" remains our guiding principle. 


We humbly request your understanding and continued support. Your patience has been instrumental in bringing us to this milestone.

With deepest gratitude,
The 7 FUNNY Team
